title: Red Hat Security Advisory: crun security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-47766) affecting crun, an OCI runtime, allows arbitrary file creation or overwriting via symlink following. Red Hat has issued an important security update addressing this issue in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support and related variants. The vulnerability is rated as having a high severity impact. Users of affected Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 versions should apply the provided update to mitigate this risk.
